title: Genetic Algorithms in Search, Optimization and Machine Learning
relevance: Canonical reference for genetic algorithm theory including schema theorem and building block hypothesis; provides the theoretical foundation for the bit-level crossover and selection operators used in this module.

title: An Introduction to Genetic Algorithms
relevance: Accessible treatment of GA design principles, fitness landscape theory, and Royal Roads experiments; informs the choice of tournament selection and adaptive mutation strategies.

title: Reference energy extremal optimization: applied to computational protein design
relevance: Demonstrates extremal optimization on rugged biophysical fitness landscapes; provides analogical precedent for applying evolutionary search to combinatorial optimization problems with sparse optima.
